effect: Marking the lit stalls on Moth's map completed the remaining goal and made clear that the grey gap reflects missing directory data, not an empty neighborhood.
reaction: The contrast between the map and the living market was a satisfying conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Powering the market lights and marking the stalls on the map connected the practical repair to the neighborhood's larger problem.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to connect the sheltered lights directly to the battery was frustrating because the need to prepare the fused supply first was not clear to me.

surprise.text: Fitting the reflector also secured the lamp's loose joint; I had expected the repair roll to do that separately.

arbitrary.text: The order of the market-light fittings felt somewhat arbitrary: the strips accepted the offcuts before the lead, and the battery needed a separate fused supply.

continue.text: Yes. The repairs had tangible payoffs, and I would like to see whether the marked map helps challenge the directory's account of the neighborhood.
